Backbone: redesigned hydrolase active-site scaffold
Length: 110 residues (positions 1-110)

Fixed functional positions (catalytic triad -- must be preserved exactly):
  position 31  = H (His)
  position 55  = D (Asp)
  position 102 = S (Ser)

These three residues are the catalytic machinery; the backbone exists to hold
them in geometry. Everything else is yours to design.

Composition notes: aim for a realistic, diverse globular-domain sequence. Avoid
